# Shraddha Kulkarni

> Shraddha Kulkarni works at Sarvam AI in Bangalore, India. Sarvam is the foundational AI company of India. She looks after the speech-to-text APIs and the go-to-market for them. She works with some of the biggest brands in India.

## What she does

- Helps teams build voice agents with LiveKit, Pipecat, and other open source frameworks.
- Works to make voice agents sound natural.
- Works with the model team. She shares what an ML pipeline for speech should look like and what feedback should go back into model training.

## Background

Before Sarvam, she was a product manager at ZS Associates (2023 to 2026), building AI products for pharma. She trained as an electronics engineer at R.V. College of Engineering.
